# walls.rip

> walls.rip — Anonymous communication toolkit. Break walls for private, uncensored communication.

## What is walls.rip?

walls.rip is a suite of privacy-first communication tools that require no identity, accounts, or personal data. All tools are designed with zero-knowledge principles — the server never sees your plaintext.

## Tools

### Ghost Mail
Disposable encrypted email inboxes. Create temporary email addresses with optional PGP encryption. Available in three tiers:
- BASIC (free): Random address, standard domains, 30-minute session
- PREMIUM (~$1 XMR): Custom name, premium domains, extended time, PGP
- PRIVATE (~$3 XMR): Full control, all domains, max duration, PGP + extensions

### Dead Drop
Self-destructing encrypted messages using AES-256-GCM. Encryption happens entirely in the browser — the server stores only ciphertext. The decryption key lives in the URL fragment and never reaches the server. Configurable TTL: 10 minutes to 3 days.

### SMS Wall
Anonymous phone number verification. Get temporary numbers for SMS verification across 150+ countries and 300+ services. No identity required. Auto-refund if SMS not received.

### Ghost Chat (Coming Soon)
End-to-end encrypted messaging over decentralized Nostr relays. Ephemeral identities, no server trust.

## Privacy Principles

- Zero Identity: No accounts, emails, or phone numbers required
- Client-Side Crypto: Encryption in the browser, server never sees plaintext
- No Logs: No IP logging, no user-agent storage, no analytics
- XMR Payments: Premium features paid with Monero for untraceable transactions
